cases.name: inherited-valid
cases.source: class B { constructor(public value: number) {} } class C extends B {} const Alias = C; new Alias(3);

cases.name: inherited-invalid
cases.source: class B { constructor(public value: number) {} } class C extends B {} const Alias = C; new Alias("bad");

diagnostics.message: Argument of type 'string' is not assignable to parameter of type 'number'.

cases.name: protected-alias
cases.source: class B { protected constructor() {} } const Alias = B; new Alias();

diagnostics.message: Constructor of class 'B' is protected and only accessible within the class declaration.

cases.name: private-alias
cases.source: class B { private constructor() {} } const Alias = B; new Alias();

diagnostics.message: Constructor of class 'B' is private and only accessible within the class declaration.

cases.name: protected-signature
cases.source: class B { protected constructor() {} } type Ctor = new () => B; const ctor: Ctor = B;

diagnostics.message:
Type 'typeof B' is not assignable to type 'Ctor'.
  Cannot assign a 'protected' constructor type to a 'public' constructor type.

cases.name: generic-concrete

cases.name: imported-inherited

cases.name: generic-constraint-valid
cases.source: class B<T extends string> { constructor(public value: T) {} } type Ctor = new (value: string) => {value: string}; const ctor: Ctor = B;

cases.name: generic-constraint-invalid
cases.source: class B<T extends string> { constructor(public value: T) {} } type Ctor = new (value: number) => {value: number}; const ctor: Ctor = B;

diagnostics.message:
Type 'typeof B' is not assignable to type 'Ctor'.
  Types of construct signatures are incompatible.
    Type 'new <T extends string>(value: T) => B<T>' is not assignable to type 'new (value: number) => { value: number; }'.
      Types of parameters 'value' and 'value' are incompatible.
        Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'.

cases.name: generic-inconsistent-result
cases.source: class B<T> { constructor(public value: T) {} } type Ctor = new (value: number) => {value: string}; const ctor: Ctor = B;

diagnostics.message:
Types of construct signatures are incompatible.
  Type 'new <T>(value: T) => B<T>' is not assignable to type 'new (value: number) => { value: string; }'.
    Construct signature return types 'B<number>' and '{ value: string; }' are incompatible.
      The types of 'value' are incompatible between these types.
        Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'.
